# Genesis Apocryphon Column 11 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QapGen (Cave 1), Col. 11 | **Condition:** Nearly destroyed

---

**11:1** [...] sacrifices [...] he constructed an altar [...]

**11:2** [...] Noah presented [...] burnt offerings on the altar [...]

**11:3** [...] the Lord breathed in [...] the sweet fragrance [...]

**11:4** [...] God pronounced his blessing [...] on Noah and his sons [...]

**11:5** [...] a covenant [...] between myself and you [...]

**11:6** [...] and with every living thing [...]

**11:7** [...] never again will [...] floodwaters destroy [...]

**11:8** [...] the rainbow [...] set in the clouds [...]

**11:9** [...] an enduring sign of the covenant [...] for every generation to come [...]

**11:10** [...]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 11 brings the flood cycle to its redemptive close. Noah builds an altar, offers sacrifice, and God responds with blessing and an eternal covenant. The bow in the clouds — a warrior's weapon laid aside — becomes the sign that divine wrath has yielded to divine mercy. Even in fragments, this is a moment of cosmic reconciliation.*
